description_html:
Start drawing on a graphic tablet that combines the best features with a good drawing area of 7.5 x 5 inches in a sleek design that is a leather case that contains the tablet with the pen and paper. Equipped with a pen that does not need to be charged or battery to work, and supports 8192 levels of pressure sensitivity.

The tablet also works with basic programs such as: (Photoshop, SAI, Painter Clip Studio, Krita) and more, suitable for professionals and beginners. Also compatible with a variety of office programs: ONENOTE, PDF, WPS, WORD, PPT and more. You can connect it to your computer or mobile phone, it is compatible with: Windows 7/8/8.1 / or later Mac OS 10.12 or later Android 6 or higher *Note: The driver is (Chinese Interface ) Package contents Gaomon M5 Graphic Tablet Battery-free pen 10 x nibs Tyb-C to Micro adapter Cable Tybe.C To Micro Nib removal tool Case + paper
description_text:
Start drawing on a graphic tablet that combines the best features with a good drawing area of 7.5 x 5 inches in a sleek design that is a leather case that contains the tablet with the pen and paper.
Equipped with a pen that does not need to be charged or battery to work, and supports 8192 levels of pressure sensitivity.
The tablet also works with basic programs such as: (Photoshop, SAI, Painter Clip Studio, Krita) and more, suitable for professionals and beginners.
Also compatible with a variety of office programs: ONENOTE, PDF, WPS, WORD, PPT and more.
You can connect it to your computer or mobile phone, it is compatible with:
Windows 7/8/8.1 / or later
Mac OS 10.12 or later
Android 6 or higher
*Note: The driver is (Chinese Interface )

Gaomon M5 Graphic Tablet
Battery-free pen

Nib removal tool
Case + paper
description_html_ar:
ابدأ الرسم على جرافيك تابلت GAOMON M5 الذي يجمع بين أفضل الإمكانيات بمساحة جيدة للرسم تبلُغ 7.5 x 5

بوصة بتصميم راقي عبارة عن جراب جلد يحتوي على الجهاز اللوحي مع القلم والأوراق 


مزود بـ قلم لا يحتاج إلى شحن أو بطارية للعمل، ويدعم 8192 مستوى من مستويات حساسية الضغط   


يعمل ايضا الجهاز اللوحي مع البرامج الاساسية  مثل :

(Photoshop ، SAI ، Painter Clip Studio ، Krita) وأكثر من ذلك، مناسبة للمحترفين و المبتدئين.

متوافق أيضاً مع مجموعة متنوعة من البرامج المكتبية:

ONENOTE و PDF و WPS و WORD و PPT والمزيد


يمكنك توصيله بجهازك الكمبيوتر أو الموبايل فهو يتوافق مع : 

  Windows 7/8/8.1/  أو أحدث 

Mac OS 10.12 أو أحدث 

Android 6 او اعلى
* ملحوظة الدرايفر Chinese interface


محتويات العلبة
جرافيك تابلت Gaomon M5

قلم يعمل بدون شحن أو بطارية
10 x سنون 

محول من Tyb-C إلى Micro  مشبك استبدال السن كابل Tybe-c لـ Micro

الجراب +الورق
